summary: Assess transition plans, climate claims, and financing assumptions. Practise due diligence questions, conditions, and monitoring indicators.
lede: Climate transition plan assessment helps lenders and investors judge whether a borrower’s plans and financing assumptions support a credible transition. For bankers, investment analysts, and corporate and project-finance teams, the training covers due diligence on emissions baselines, target credibility, transition governance, capital-expenditure alignment, and scenario sensitivity, then applies findings to financing conditions and monitoring indicators.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess climate transition evidence in lending, investment, corporate finance, and project finance decisions.
prerequisites: Prior experience in banking, investment analysis, corporate finance, sustainability, or development finance is recommended. Familiarity with basic financial statements and financing decisions will help you apply the case exercises. No programming is required. A laptop with Microsoft Excel or compatible spreadsheet software is recommended.
